attr.title: GlitchScope
attr.desc: GlitchScope — plays MP3/FLAC/Ogg with real-time MilkDrop visualizations. Drop your music files into /roms/ports/glitchscope/ and enjoy a psychedelic audio experience on your handheld.
attr.inst: Copy song.mp3 (or any MP3/FLAC/Ogg) to /roms/ports/glitchscope/. Presets are in /roms/ports/glitchscope/presets/.
